answer: Anchor every epoch's payout to one duty: each identity must name a plausible sybil cluster, or earn nothing. Verified hits pay a bounty; false accusations are fined. Honest agents scan an open ocean and spot real farms cheaply. The operator is trapped: their own heads are the sybils they know best, but reporting them sinks their own harvest, while framing innocents invites fines. Like the roots of a single cedar, the duty pins each identity to one honest stake — hunt your own kind or forfeit everything.
